body.statement: Uniformly over \(n\ge1\) and \(d\ge2\), \(c_\epsilon L_{n,d}\le R_{n,d,\epsilon}\le C_\epsilon U_{n,d}\).
body.justification: The bracket localizes the unresolved theorem to sparse and transitional categories while preserving every original nuisance feature.
body.gap: No located paper combines the separated-law and unknown-mass obstructions in one observational risk bracket.
body.consumer: The bracket gives sample-size diagnostics that remain valid before the exact sparse frontier is solved.
